newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates surge up on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates surge up on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates surged in a cash-short market at Monday's close and dealers said rates were likely to stay high on Tuesday.
Onvernight funds were initially offered in a narrow band of 19.90 to 20 percent, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said, adding most trades took place at 20 percent.
He said heavy amounts were discounted by the central bank and borrowers that could not avail the discounting facility had to borrow from the market at 21 percent and 23 percent.
